categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `dumptxoutset` handling in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: It fixes file corruption and prune-lock collisions from concurrent `dumptxoutset` invocations and avoids heavy wasteful UTXO copies on stale rollback targets. While dumptxoutset is an administrative command and these are edge cases, addressing file corruption and unnecessary expensive operations provides clear value.
